translationRepairs: His grandson Yuwen, top graduate of the first rank in the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang, rose to provincial judicial commissioner of Zhejiang;

s0066 names 孫毓溎; 毓溎 is Yugui, while s0067's distinct 毓汶 is Yuwen. The prior idiomatic wrongly collapses both into Yuwen; Yugui restores the Chinese name.

s0066 has 孫毓溎, distinct from s0067 毓汶. Literal Yuwen is a false romanization of 毓溎; Yugui matches the characters and separates the two grandsons.

In the eighteenth year, responding to an edict, he memorialized in summary: "Our dynasty's accumulated merit over generations rests with the people, yet disorderly people pityingly do not fear the law and changes arise unexpectedly—all this comes from failure to repair official governance.

In the eighteenth year, responding to an edict, he memorialized in summary: "Our dynasty's accumulated merit over generations rests with the people, yet disorderly people recklessly do not fear the law and upheavals arise unexpectedly—all this comes from failure to repair official governance.
s0083 亂民愍不畏法 uses 愍 as reckless disregard, not pity; pityingly invents that sense. Recklessly and upheavals for 變出意外 restore the memorial's meaning.
